description.value: La Cervecería Astilleros is a Mexican-inspired craft brewery and taproom in the Shipyards district of Lower Lonsdale, bringing Mexican ingredients and brewing traditions to BC craft beer. Their award-winning Salted Lime Lager took first place at the 2023 Canadian Brewing Awards, and a constantly rotating small-batch tap list means there is always something new on pour. Cyclists can refuel with tacos, burritos, and margaritas alongside the house lagers, with both indoor and outdoor seating available.

address.value: 226 Esplanade E, North Vancouver BC, V7L 1A3

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces, covered) at 79m; stands (2 spaces, covered) at 84m. Total: 4 spaces.
